cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: the paved square before a city gate tower — standing; a grand museum hall with marble statues at night — holds a freshly printed instant photo up to the light; the Zhuge Liang shrine on the Wuzhang Plains plateau — rests a red oil-paper umbrella open on her shoulder; a quiet city tram-stop platform at dawn — she is delightedly taking a first bite from a very large steamed breakfast bun before the tram arrives; a small outdoor carnival rehearsal yard with striped fabric pavilions — she is trying the padded seat of a miniature fairground ride; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — carries a camera by its grip at her side; a scholar's study stacked with bound bamboo slips — holds a magnifying glass by its handle at chest height; terraced tea fields on a misty Sichuan hillside — kneeling on the ground; the Wuhou Shrine in Chengdu — kneeling on the ground; a hydroponic bathing pool aboard a starship — chest-deep in the water; a neon-lit game arcade — takes a bite from a cloud of pink cotton candy on a stick; a floating sky garden of hanging vines and flowering terraces above the clouds — crouching low on her heels; an outdoor theatre of tiered seats facing a stage — hugs a striped tub of popcorn against her side
